name: pi Ventures
identity_check: pi Ventures (styled lowercase 'pi'; ET writes 'Pi Ventures') at piventures.in: a Bengaluru early-stage deep-tech and AI venture firm founded in 2016 by Manish Singhal. Investment manager Pi Partners LLP runs two SEBI Category I AIFs, PI VENTURES INVESTMENT TRUST (IN/AIF1/16-17/0236) and PI VENTURES INVESTMENT TRUST II (IN/AIF1/20-21/0867), per the firm's investor-relations page; fund closes confirmed in ET and CNBC-TV18. Not pi.ventures (a parked domain that redirects to a parking lander), not Lightspeed Venture Partners (LightSpeed Photonics is a pi portfolio company), not Pi Network or PI Industries.

thesis_text.value: Early-stage deep-tech and AI investor in Bengaluru backing Indian founders, or startups with a strong India connection, that build IP-led, 10x-better technology for global markets. Primarily seed and Series A, open to pre-revenue companies with strong tech. Focus spans AI/ML, robotics, energy, life sciences, quantum, advanced materials, semiconductors and space; offers hands-on, fill-the-gaps founder support.

open_items: No application form: the FAQ says to send pitch decks to the firm's general email address or contact the team on LinkedIn, so application_url is left out.

Flipped / US-domiciled companies: not addressed explicitly. The FAQ focuses on Indian startups and allows international ones with a 'Deep India Connect'; the portfolio includes LightSpeed Photonics (HQ Singapore) and Helex (Hyderabad- and US-based). requires_us_entity is 'no' because Indian entities are the stated default.

Industrial / manufacturing is not a stated sector, but the Armatrix post says pi invests in companies solving critical bottlenecks in established industries; the portfolio has SwitchOn (AI quality inspection for manufacturing) and Armatrix (industrial inspection robots).

Fund III: ET (30 Jun 2026) reports early talks to raise a third fund while exiting Fund I holdings; size and target are behind a paywall. ET (12 Oct 2026) lists pi as an applicant to the government RDI scheme, but the 19 selected managers were not named. No Fund III close found.

Departures per ET (Jun 2026): cofounder Umakant Soni, former MD Roopan Aulakh and former partner Abhishek Surendran. ET (Dec 2025) quotes Sohil Bhagat as a pi managing director, but he is not on the current team page, so he is not listed as a partner.
Manish Singhal's and Milan Roy's sector focus is not stated separately from the firm's; focus_sectors left empty.

Armatrix (Feb 2026): the firm's post announces the investment but gives no amount, stage, lead or co-investors; ET (Aug 2026) gives only a cumulative Rs 18.42 crore raised from investors including Pi Ventures, GradCapital, Boundless Ventures, Inuka Capital, Boost VC, Turbostart, WTF Fund and Emergent Ventures. No round article found.
Round stage not stated for Quanfluence (Oct 2026), Pranos, Velmenni, Aule Space, Moonrider and LightSpeed Photonics. SwitchOn (2019) seed amount not published on the firm's post.

Company websites and founded years come from pi's portfolio pages (links to the companies' sites were not opened). HQ countries for Aule Space, Helex, Repello AI and SwitchOn are not clear from the sources.

Web search budget was used up; rounds were found via the firm's insights page and ET topic pages. Entrackr, Inc42 and YourStory coverage of the 2025-26 rounds was not checked, so most rounds rest on one press page plus the firm's own post.
Fund II LPs (no schema field): BII, Nippon India Digital Innovation AIF, Accel, Colruyt, Premji Invest, SIDBI Fund of Funds (Rs 100 Cr) plus entrepreneurs and family offices (CNBC TV18, ET).
Older rounds not researched: RagaAI ($4.7M seed led by pi, Jan 2024), Ottonomy, Silence Laboratories, Preimage, Zero Cow Factory, Clean Electric, Ahammune.
